blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535319 on 2026-07-15, the ERC-1967 proxy delegates to verified Stablecoin implementation 0x69edf9fa820df057e493635ed1db6b9e5f8124a0; its admin and beacon slots were zero. FREEZER_ROLE was held by EOA 0x77149912943A7b3bD743e1820666314349b9Cf25 and BLACKLISTER_ROLE by EOA 0xfbe09e1AC164565ea20B974Bca4B3C0fb79cd13a, while paused() was false. Verified code makes pause() block ERC20 updates and makes transfer/transferFrom reject blacklisted senders and recipients; eth_call simulations from those role holders succeeded. MASTER_MINTER_ROLE EOA 0x06720DEc0fA18BB540EEA24C7f196c0BD0C26B7A can also destroy a blacklisted holder's funds. At finalized Solana slot 432983437, the Token-2022 mint exposed freeze authority AJ7yvciE9bn1m1hrFBtKB1fS3K5eYfJwUoNk3nZDp1XS, pausableConfig authority BB67z1U8YfHFPwrDzzTiAYPNUiU86oiATYAyYnE5Xqkq, and permanentDelegate BB67z1U8YfHFPwrDzzTiAYPNUiU86oiATYAyYnE5Xqkq; it was not paused. These are direct on-chain holder-control paths, so SOFID is Yes. Issuer product, legal, infrastructure, and attestation materials were checked for context; account-level restrictions are not the basis for this classification.
